## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran, any skipped checks and how to reproduce the result.
For interface changes, include a screenshot or recording using synthetic data.

## Target branch

- [ ] This targets `dev`, or is a current-release fix/release promotion targeting `main`.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated and no secrets, raw traces, weights or generated native files are included.

For a fix targeting `main`, note how it will be merged forward into `dev`.
See `CONTRIBUTING.md` for checks and branch policy.
